selectOptions._about: Options the runner's select helper (plan B2) applies to a record's steps. All are optional.
selectOptions.skipQuizzes: quiz steps to drop, by their answer variable
selectOptions.skipFirstSpeak: drop the first { speak } step (the frame already showed it)
selectOptions.untilVerb: keep steps before the first step with this verb
selectOptions.window: { from: {key: value}, to: {key: value} }: the inclusive run of steps from the first match to the next match
selectOptions.insertAfter: { match, from: { record, window } }: insert another record's window after the first matching step
selectOptions.haggle: { rounds: n }: the haggle verb closes after n counter rounds
